sentence: This project studies how microscopic features of an item's surface, captured by cameras, can be used to authenticate products and stop counterfeits.
This project studies how eye tracking can measure when learners are focused or distracted and guide their attention during virtual reality training.
This project builds a method to stretch soft materials with smoothly changing properties and measure how they deform inside in three dimensions.
This project builds a digital platform that gathers pet health records into one place and predicts pet healthspan and mortality risk.
This project builds control and planning methods that let drones adjust their performance as their computing resources are moved between tasks.
This project studies how rats use rearing on their hind legs to take in information and how the hippocampus supports spatial memory.
This project explores materials for quantum technologies and materials that withstand extreme conditions, using artificial intelligence and neutron scattering.
This project builds automated ways to survey coral reefs and other marine ecosystems using underwater robotic vehicles, 3D modeling and artificial intelligence.
This project studies how humanoid robots can catch and throw heavy objects using only the cameras and sensors on their own bodies.
This project builds a way to protect industrial control systems from cyber-attacks using machine learning that human operators can understand, plus recovery control.
This project develops mathematical tools to explain how diffusion models make their outputs and to extend them to complex data such as graphs and sets.
This project studies how stiffness patterns in the rear fins of fish and marine mammals shape the flow of water around them in three dimensions.
This project develops technologies for autonomous aircraft, aiming to improve their performance, safety and reliability using artificial intelligence, control and robotics.
This project studies how climate change and evolution affect Arctic river and tundra ecosystems, from genes to whole landscapes.
This project studies how a hurricane changed the functions and variety of microbes living in soil, and how well those microbes resisted and recovered.
This project builds an artificial intelligence tool that scores predicted protein structures and ranks them by accuracy.
This project uses theory to study how many quantum particles cooled to very low temperatures and confined to a line behave over time.
This project designs shape memory alloy films with nanoscale changes in composition and structure so they stretch and recover smoothly and waste less energy.
This project works on technologies that restore function to people with disabilities, such as neuroprostheses and assistive robotics.
